title: Muslim companion: Dhikr
description: A comprehensive Islamic lifestyle application designed to support daily worship with features like prayer times, Quran, and more.
longDescription: Muslim companion: Dhikr is an ad-free Islamic utility app focused on providing a clean and seamless experience for users. It helps in tracking daily prayers, reading the Quran, and finding the Qibla direction, among other features.
features: Accurate Prayer Times with Athan notifications
Quran with translations and audio recitations

title: SHA-STACK
description: A full-stack application showcase focusing on modern web development patterns and clean architecture.
longDescription: SHA-STACK is a demonstration project that explores various full-stack technologies. It serves as a playground for implementing advanced features like real-time updates, secure authentication, and optimized performance. The project is currently under active development and serves as a living document of architectural best practices.
features: Firebase Integration for Hosting and Database
